'''Quilon Aerodrome''' or '''Kollam Airport''' was an [[aerodrome]] in the city of [[Kollam]] in the former state of [[Travancore]], now in [[Kerala]], India.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://english.mathrubhumi.com/features/specials/national-cashew-day-export-celebrates-100-years-first-export-done-from-kollam-1.4301487 |title=National Cashew Day: Export celebrates 100 years; first export done from Kollam |publisher=Mathrubhumi |date=2019-11-22 |access-date=2019-11-23}}</ref> During the 1920s, there were no other civil aerodromes in the kingdoms of [[Kingdom of Cochin|Cochin]], Travancore and the [[Malabar District]] at the time of the [[British Raj|British ruled]] [[Madras Presidency]]. With the commissioning of [[Trivandrum International Airport]] in 1932 at state capital {{convert|57|km}} to the south, the aerodrome fell into disuse and came to be known as the [[Asramam Maidan]].

The landing strip of the aerodrome was strengthened with red [[laterite]] soil from the adjoining hills because the local loose soil was unsuitable for the purpose. There were no buildings in the aerodrome, but a circular concrete pad for parking aircraft was built. The aerodrome was under the control of the [[Kerala Public Works Department|Public Works Department (PWD)]]. The aerodrome was also used for training operations. These were stopped when an accident involving a training aircraft at the boundary of the aerodrome resulted in the death of the pilot and the trainee.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.thehindu.com/todays-paper/tp-national/tp-kerala/article252269.ece |title=Aviation school proposal evokes mixed response |work=The Hindu |date=2009-06-08 |access-date=2014-09-15}}</ref>

==Proposal for an aviation academy at old airport==
From 2009 to 2012, local authorities made plans to revive the aerodrome for a flying academy<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.newindianexpress.com/states/kerala/article105423.ece |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20141107020711/http://www.newindianexpress.com/states/kerala/article105423.ece |url-status=dead |archive-date=7 November 2014 |title=Runway: Team visits Asramam Maidan |publisher=TNIE |access-date=2014-09-15}}</ref> with a 4,000 foot runway for light aircraft. However, since the site was surrounded by several high-rising structures like buildings and cell phone towers and the proposal met with objections from the local population, the plans were discarded.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.newindianexpress.com/cities/thiruvananthapuram/article107040.ece |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140727055933/http://www.newindianexpress.com/cities/thiruvananthapuram/article107040.ece |url-status=dead |archive-date=27 July 2014 |title='Asramam Maidan not suitable for airport' |publisher=TNIE |access-date=2014-09-15}}</ref>

==Revival of airstrip plans==
The [[Government of Kerala]] started plans to set up ten airstrips in Kerala including one at Asramam Old Airport area. In February 2020, the state government submitted a feasibility study report to the Civil Aviation Ministry of India in this regard.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.theweek.in/news/biz-tech/2020/02/03/Kerala-plans-airstrips-to-connect-tourists-spots.html |title=Kerala plans airstrips to connect tourists spots |publisher=The Week |date=2020-02-03 |access-date=2020-02-03}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.livemint.com/news/india/kerala-may-soon-have-a-string-of-airstrips-heliports-to-connect-tourists-spots-11580722982096.html |title=Kerala may soon have a string of airstrips-heliports to connect tourists spots |publisher=Live Mint |date=2020-02-04 |access-date=2020-02-04}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://sahiwal.tv/a-wire-of-runway-heliport-to-connect-tourist-spots-in-kerala-soon/ |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200204081442/https://sahiwal.tv/a-wire-of-runway-heliport-to-connect-tourist-spots-in-kerala-soon/ |url-status=usurped |archive-date=4 February 2020 |title=A CABLE OF RUNWAY-HELIPORT FOR CONNECTING TRAVELER PLACES IN KERALA SHORTLY |publisher=Sahiwal.tv |date=2020-02-04 |access-date=2020-02-04}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://in.news.yahoo.com/kerala-plans-airstrips-connect-tourists-085110151.html |title=Kerala plans airstrips to connect tourists spots |publisher=Yahoo News |date=2020-02-04 |access-date=2020-02-04}}</ref>
